about: Stage R G0a pre-registration (OpenProject #160, epic #48; pilot plan v3.2, tools/media-repair-harness/docs/pilot-plan-v3.md sections 4.1 to 4.4 and 6). Loaded and validated by scripts/stage_r_driver.py. Keys the driver does not read are registered records for the reviewers and the report; PREREGISTRATION.md lists where every section 4.2 item 1 element lives. Roles are labels: they are here and in no case template.

pod_resolution.rule: kubectl exec resolves deploy/bazarr to its pod; at G0b the driver reads the pods of the deployment's matchLabels selector (read-only kubectl get pods): exactly one pod, Ready, with the app container's restartCount; its name, UID and restartCount are recorded as the baseline (stage-r-state.json pod) and the name must equal the hostname the first receipt binds. Every later pod check must match that baseline.

procedure: 1. Read the TV library mount path from Bazarr's deployment volume mounts (A0 read-only kubectl get deploy): exactly one mount of container app fully matching mount_path_regex.
3. list <series dir>: season directories matched exactly by ^Season 0?3$ and ^Season 20$, each unique.

Each of the four listings must be complete. A target's locator is accepted only when exactly one listed entry matches it: a recorded basename and its bytes, or for S03E01 and S03E02 the bytes and the S03E01/S03E02 marker in the name (the basename found is recorded as discovered, not as a baseline). No unique match drops the target. Nothing is inferred from episode titles.
discovery.mount_rule_source: haynes-ops kubernetes/main/apps/media/bazarr/app/helmrelease.yaml at 1c514a7b: the app container mounts /config, /data/haynestower (NFS haynestower.haynesnetwork:/mnt/user/data) and /tmp; the library is under /data/haynestower
discovery.known_gap: the TV library is not its own mount: the 2026-10-18 receipts (.agents/context/media-repair-av-2026-10-18) read TV files under /data/haynestower/Media/TV Shows, so step 2 run on the mount root finds no series directory and G0b stops (PREREGISTRATION.md section 2)
